No Instavar account or API key is required for the nine public tools. An optional Instavar API key unlocks separate hosted Studio workflows, which may incur costs.
localizations.summary:
Start without an Instavar account or API key. Install @instavar/mcp-server and call get_capabilities. Use get_creative_guide before drafting copy or design; choose a supported structure with list_templates and get_template, then use get_example or scaffold_video_spec. get_render_instructions describes the separate local validate, preview and render workflow. Planning and scaffolding do not render, upload or publish media.

The default npm 0.6.0 connection exposes ten tools and four creative-guide resources. INSTAVAR_API_KEY is optional, not a setup requirement: configure it only for hosted Studio jobs, rendering, review, publishing and metrics. Hosted production may incur costs and publishing requires explicit user approval.

For browser-based agents, https://instavar.com/api/mcp/templates is a related but different HTTP service with storyboard and carousel planning plus OAuth private-project review. Its version and tool inventory must not be confused with this npm listing.

Instavar is independent of Remotion AG. Public setup instructions and examples: https://instavar.com/remotion.
